limits: One local real-Redis cancellation case only. Acceptance of this evidence is not complete M4 acceptance, production readiness, C0 tracing, deployment/merge/publication permission or authorization for any execution, rerun, retry or renewal.

The approval is consumed/nonreusable irrespective of review result. The immutable local records and one-use source path support one recorded invocation; they are not signed third-party attestation or a global process audit.
Independent resource absence is point-in-time and by exact NAMES and labels only. Container IDs were not retained; by-ID absence checks performed: zero.

Four container admission records retain expected closed specs, verified flags and inspection hashes, not raw inspect values. Image metadata was independently inspected now; historical image filesystem checks were reconciled, not rerun.

Only five complete stage envelopes are retained; the two ready completions are journal-only. Isolation receipts are stage observations, not continuous network/process tracing. Redis container isolation is source-gated admission, not an executor process-inventory receipt for Redis.

Private credentials, owners, tokens, fixture identities, full state snapshots, responses and generated ACL bytes were discarded. Runtime callbacks plus retained hashes cannot independently establish their raw preimages; no reconstruction or raw-value proof is claimed.

The startup/probe kill/restart and zero-loss-bound bootstrap receipt concern one acknowledged preliminary probe. They do not establish all-state AOF durability, production crash consistency or broad loss guarantees.
Two serial logical owners share one ledger credential and one measurement worker. This is not simultaneous physical-worker concurrency or per-owner credential isolation.

The single B request start is a synthetic unused grant; no crawl/render/fetch or external I/O is established or authorized. Zero rate intervals do not prove positive-interval or independent origin blocking.
Absolute expiry/tombstone projections were checked; no one-day wall-clock aging or expiry event was observed.

Gitleaks evidence is a retained signature scan with zero findings, not a proof of absence of every private value. The reviewer verified provenance, scanner/config pins and byte-identical coverage but did not rerun the scanner.

PR20 all-14-check success is bound to retained CI metadata and approved source, not newly queried GitHub state. No complete repository security audit or independent rerun of the previous 19 cases was performed.

observations.detail: Old approval was already expired at its check, refused before reservation, recorded zero invocations and closed unused. Renewed owner artifact approval and separate execute decision bind the same commit/plan/recipe and unchanged 300-second budget; only expiry changed. O_EXCL reservation binds the one recorded invocation. Approval remains consumed and nonreusable regardless of this verdict.

All 16 request artifact hashes, renewed decision hashes, original hashes, exact commit blobs, regenerated pure recipe, and Redis/harness image pins reconcile. The 300-second case window fit with 2271596 ms spare at invocation; all 28 lifecycle actions and final return precede expiry. Recorded duration is 14130 ms monotonic, 14129 ms wall-clock; no case retry. The retained PR20 CI gate records 14 successful required contexts on the approved head; this review did not refresh GitHub state.

Original INCOMPLETE intent names the exact six resources, predates the first mutation receipt and is fsynced before Docker mutation in source. Original journal is canonical compact JSONL with contiguous sequences 0-27, monotone integer times, 2904 bytes, matching report actions and retained device/inode digest. No copy was substituted, no prefix repaired, no original file mode or identity changed. Both independent and source read-only parsers agree.

Exactly four closed role specs match source and approved images. Init alone uses UID0 and CHOWN; later roles use UID65534 without added capabilities. Source admission requires network none, read-only root, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, no bind/device/port/host namespace extras, bounded memory/CPU/PIDs and exact owned mounts. All five retained stage envelopes pass complete isolation validation with zero external routes and two allowed processes; the known fallback interfaces are inactive. Seven stage actions exist, including two ready completions retained only in the journal. Inspection/process hashes are not substituted for missing raw observations.

Early setup/loader/boot receipts each show held-session termination and denied reconnect against a reachable server. Final receipts cover all six roles: those three already revoked, ledger/observer/revoker newly terminated, all reconnects denied. Source accepts only WRONGPASS for reconnect denial and receive EOF/reset for held-session loss, not timeout or a dead server. Source processes revoker last; this order is source-backed, not inferred from sorted JSON object order. Stopped PID0 worker removal precedes creation of the fresh separately named revocation container in actions 17-20.

Nine fixed cancellation steps, 60-counter before/after chains, exactly five state-changing steps, one capacity denial and two cancellation replays reconcile. A never starts a request; B starts one synthetic unused grant. Replaying A cancellation after B claims does not release B capacity. All 46 source-matched authority-negative command receipts are NOPERM with unchanged final state digest. Measurement span is 3323 ms. Terminal absolute expiry projections match one-day tombstones without claiming observed aging. Raw fixture identities/state/replies and generated ACL bytes were discarded and cannot be independently regenerated from hashes.

Cleanup source, retained cleanup rows and journal agree: helper/worker/init containers are absent before Redis removal, then control and data volumes are removed. Independent Docker inspect found the four exact container names and two exact volume names absent; successful list queries were empty for fixture, case and image-check labels across both kinds. Explicit no-such-object responses, not daemon/permission failures, establish named absence. No container IDs were retained and no by-ID absence is claimed.

The retained zero-finding original-five Gitleaks scan covers 97810 bytes. Scan copies are byte-identical to originals; scanner hash, default config, empty ignore, report and scan-log hashes reconcile. Raw controller logs were handled privately and not copied into the review. Source sends transient random credentials in bounded stdin, not environment/command arguments, uses hashed ACL entries and removes owned volumes. Signature scanning and hash callbacks do not prove the absence or correctness of discarded private values. No new scan or case execution was performed.

All 108 working source hashes equal the pinned commit blobs. The 43 Lua files plus contract documentation, vectors, generator and generated bundle (47 files) equal the base commit. Source diff adds the closed cancellation case without changing existing admission/revocation/lifecycle controls or accepted case limits. Plan and scope remain conformance-only; image validation's 74 source hashes reconcile with this inventory. No old accepted case is reclassified or expanded by this review.
